name: Meteora
description: Meteora, in Thessaly in northwestern Greece, is a cluster of towering sandstone pillars crowned with Orthodox monasteries, set between the town of Kalabaka and the village of Kastraki. Monks began settling on these "columns of the sky" in the 11th century, and twenty-four monasteries were eventually built. Six survive today, and four are still home to monks or nuns and open to visitors. Their frescoes are a highlight.
